description: Given invoiceNumber and recordId: look up the Xero invoice with the xero-accounting list_invoices tool (invoiceNumbers filter). Return paid = true when its Status is PAID or AmountDue is 0, plus status. Then move the Payment promise record recordId to stage kept if paid, otherwise broken.

flowIr.description: Looks up one Xero invoice by number. If it is paid, moves the Payment promise to Paid as promised; if not, to Promise broken. Returns paid and the Xero status.
flowIr.name: Check Xero invoice paid

nodes.code:
number = str(params.get("invoice_number") or "").strip()
result = api.connectors.invoke(
    server="xero-accounting",
    tool="list_invoices",
    args={"invoiceNumbers": number},
) if number else {}

invoices = []
if isinstance(result, dict):
    invoices = result.get("Invoices") or result.get("invoices") or []

if invoices:
    inv = invoices[0]
    status = str(inv.get("Status") or "UNKNOWN")
    amount_due = float(inv.get("AmountDue") or 0)
    paid = status == "PAID" or amount_due <= 0
else:
    status = "NOT_FOUND"
    paid = False

record_id = params.get("record_id")
if record_id:
    api.records.update(
        type_slug="payment_promise",
        record_id=record_id,
        record={"stage": "kept" if paid else "broken"},
    )

outputs.description: True when Xero shows the invoice as paid.
outputs.name: paid

outputs.description: The invoice status in Xero, or NOT_FOUND.
outputs.name: status

nodes.summary: Finds the invoice in Xero by number, says whether it is paid, and moves the Payment promise to kept or broken.
nodes.title: Check the invoice in Xero

name: Check Xero invoice paid
